personal.title: Ask a performer for a tip
personal.description: Get a performer to recommend another act at the festival (ask politely, and thank them). Proof: the act they named.

personal.title: Castle courtyard set
personal.description: Catch a set in Lancaster Castle's courtyard. Proof: who played.

personal.title: Sounds from abroad
personal.description: Find an act from outside the UK. Proof: the act's name and its country.

personal.title: Join in
personal.description: Join a workshop or a dance session instead of just watching. Proof: what you did and where (no close-ups of strangers without their OK).

personal.title: Snap a setlist
personal.description: Get hold of a band's setlist, taped to the stage or handed over after the show. Proof: the paper itself, and the band's name.

personal.title: Genre hopper
personal.description: Hear three different genres within one hour. Proof: the three genres and roughly when you heard them.

personal.title: Smallest room in town
personal.description: See a gig in the smallest venue you can find. Proof: who played and just how tiny it was.

personal.title: What is that thing?
personal.description: Find an instrument you can't name. Proof: your best guess at what it is. Bonus if the player tells you what it really is.

personal.title: Learn a move
personal.description: Get a stranger to teach you a dance move (with their OK). Proof: the move, and who taught you.

personal.title: Total unknowns
personal.description: Watch a full song from an act none of the group has heard of. Proof: who they were, and a one-line verdict.

personal.title: Sneaky singalong
personal.description: Persuade another player to sing along to something without them noticing why. Proof: the song (and a witness who caught it happening).

personal.title: Brand spotting
personal.description: Spot the festival's branding in five different venues. Proof: the five venue names.

personal.title: Hymn book, guitar edition
personal.description: Hear a set in Lancaster Priory. Proof: who played.

personal.title: An evening at The Storey
personal.description: Catch a gig at The Storey. Proof: who played.

personal.title: Curtain up at the Dukes
personal.description: Go inside Dukes Theatre during the festival. Proof: something distinctly theatrical you saw, and what was on.

personal.title: Market Square moment
personal.description: Stop in Market Square for a full song. Proof: who was playing.

personal.title: Drummer's big moment
personal.description: Catch a drummer mid-fill, sticks up and blurred (no flash, please). Proof: the band.

personal.title: Fiddle in the wild
personal.description: Find a fiddle or violin in a band that isn't classical. Proof: the band's name.

personal.title: Squeezebox sighting
personal.description: Spot an accordion, concertina or melodeon being played. Proof: which one you reckon it was.

personal.title: The bassist's face
personal.description: Find the most committed bass-playing face you can. Proof: the band, and why it wins.

personal.title: One more song
personal.description: Be in the room when a crowd earns an encore. Proof: the band, and the song they played last.

personal.title: Front of the front
personal.description: Watch a gig from the very front, hands on the barrier or stage edge if there is one. Proof: who played.

personal.title: The furthest corner
personal.description: Find the furthest corner of a venue where you can still hear the band. Proof: where it was, and what you could still hear.

personal.title: First note
personal.description: Be there for the very first note of a set. Proof: the band, and the time.

personal.title: Stay to the end
personal.description: Stay for the final song of a set, right to the last chord. Proof: the closing song.

personal.title: Merch table haul
personal.description: Pick up something from an act's merch table, even if it's only a free sticker or flyer. Proof: your haul, and the act's name.

personal.title: Autograph hunter
personal.description: Get a performer to sign something: a flyer, a setlist, your wristband. Proof: the signature, and whose it is.

personal.title: Chalk and talk
personal.description: Find a handwritten gig sign or chalkboard that tells you who is playing today. Proof: the funniest line on it.

personal.title: Behind the sound
personal.description: Catch a soundcheck. Proof: the band or venue.

personal.title: Meet the desk
personal.description: Chat to a sound engineer about their job (ask at a quiet moment). Proof: one thing you learned.

personal.title: Back the busker
personal.description: Watch a busker for a full song and leave a tip if you can. Proof: the song.

personal.title: Favourite lyric
personal.description: Ask a stranger for their favourite lyric ever. Proof: the lyric, with the song and artist.

personal.title: Festival veteran
personal.description: Find someone who has been to more Lancaster Music Festivals than you can count (ask first). Proof: how many.

personal.title: Good dog, good gig
personal.description: Find a dog having a good time near the music (ask the owner first). Proof: its name.

personal.title: Hat check
personal.description: Find the best hat in the festival (ask the wearer first). Proof: your rating out of ten.

personal.title: Band tee trivia
personal.description: Find someone in a band T-shirt and ask for their favourite album by that band. Proof: the album.

personal.title: Cover story
personal.description: Hear a cover of a song you know. Proof: the song and the original artist.

personal.title: Hands in the air
personal.description: Be part of a crowd with hands clapping or raised. Proof: the song or band.

personal.title: Bar wisdom
personal.description: Ask a bartender what has been the best seller this festival. Proof: their answer.

personal.title: Beast on a pub sign
personal.description: Find a pub sign with an animal on it. Proof: the pub's name.

personal.title: Local history
personal.description: Find a historic plaque or a blue plaque near one of the venues. Proof: what it says.

personal.title: Castle from a new angle
personal.description: See Lancaster Castle from an angle most people wouldn't pick. Proof: where you were standing.

personal.title: Fuel up
personal.description: Eat something from a street-food stall or a nearby takeaway. Proof: a rating out of ten.

personal.title: Breakfast of champions
personal.description: Have breakfast on a festival morning with something gig-related on the table (wristband, poster, flyer). Proof: the next gig you are heading to.

personal.title: Take a stranger's advice
personal.description: Ask a stranger who the best act they have seen so far is, then go and see them. Proof: who they recommended.

personal.title: Pedalboard peek
personal.description: Find a guitarist with a seriously crowded pedalboard (ask before getting close). Proof: your guess of how many pedals.

personal.title: Strangest kit
personal.description: Find the strangest drum kit or percussion setup at the festival. Proof: the oddest item in it.

personal.title: Twinning
personal.description: Spot two strangers wearing the same band T-shirt. Proof: the band.

personal.title: Critic's corner
personal.description: Write a three-line review of a set you just watched. Proof: the review itself.

personal.title: Quick sketch
personal.description: Sketch a performer in under a minute. Proof: the sketch.

personal.title: Poster selfie
personal.description: Take a selfie with the poster of an act you have just watched. Proof: the act, and your favourite song of theirs.

personal.title: Double booked
personal.description: Catch songs in two different venues within 30 minutes. Proof: the venues and the times.

personal.title: Best poster in town
personal.description: Find the best-looking gig poster in Lancaster. Proof: what makes it good.

personal.title: Catch their eye
personal.description: Get a performer to wave or point at you from the stage. Proof: the band's name.

personal.title: Outfit of the day
personal.description: Find the most ridiculous or wonderful outfit at the festival (with the wearer's OK). Proof: a name for the look.

personal.title: Cheers, strangers
personal.description: Raise a toast with people you don't know (soft drinks count). Proof: the toast.

personal.title: Local guide
personal.description: Help someone find a venue. Proof: where they were heading.

personal.title: Somewhere new
personal.description: Go inside a venue none of the group has ever been in before. Proof: its name.

personal.title: Air guitar sighting
personal.description: Catch someone in the crowd doing air guitar, air drums or air anything. Proof: the song.

personal.title: Reflecting on the gig
personal.description: Spot a band or the stage reflected in a window, a mirror or a glass. Proof: the venue and the band.

personal.title: Longest queue
personal.description: Find the longest queue outside a venue and find out what is playing. Proof: the act.

personal.title: One voice, one guitar
personal.description: Watch a solo performer with nothing but an instrument and a voice. Proof: your favourite line from their set.

personal.title: How many on stage?
personal.description: Find the band with the most people on stage. Proof: your headcount.

personal.title: Chorus buddies
personal.description: Sing a chorus with a stranger. Proof: the song.

personal.title: Name that tune
personal.description: Ask someone near you to name the tune the band is playing, and get it right between you. Proof: the song and the band.

personal.title: Tour guide
personal.description: Find out where a touring band has come from today. Proof: the longest journey you heard about.

global.title: Brass on stage
global.description: Show us a brass instrument on stage: trumpet, trombone, tuba, anything shiny. The best find wins the vote.

global.title: Best crowd shot
global.description: Show us the best crowd shot you can get. Atmosphere over perfection.

global.title: Three-player selfie
global.description: Send in a group selfie with at least three players in it. Everyone must be visible. Best framing wins.

global.title: Poster art
global.description: The most creative take on a festival poster. Angles, shadows, reflections, or something in the way: surprise the voters.

global.title: Find the folk
global.description: Find a band playing folk and show us the moment. Say who they are in your comment.

global.title: Album cover pose
global.description: Strike the best 'album cover' pose. Group poses welcome, moody stares encouraged.

global.title: Dome with a view
global.description: Your best take on the Ashton Memorial in Williamson Park. Optional if you are not up for the walk, but the dome is worth it.

global.title: Spot the Ashton
global.description: Spot the Ashton Memorial's dome from somewhere in town, not from the park. Say where you were in your comment.

global.title: Castle selfie
global.description: The best selfie with Lancaster Castle behind you. The castle must be recognisable.

global.title: Priory perspective
global.description: The best view of Lancaster Priory, inside or out.

global.title: At The Storey
global.description: The best shot of an act on stage at The Storey.

global.title: Dukes drama
global.description: The most dramatic pose in front of Dukes Theatre. Full theatrical commitment.

global.title: Market Square moment
global.description: The best moment of festival life in Market Square: a performer, a crowd, a passer-by pulling a face.

global.title: Seeing red
global.description: Find a red guitar, a red drum kit or anything red on a stage. The boldest red wins.

global.title: Hat contest
global.description: The best hat in a crowd. Ask the wearer first or shoot it from behind.

global.title: Sticks in the air
global.description: The best action shot of a drummer. Motion blur welcome, flash discouraged.

global.title: Drink with a view
global.description: The best drink of your choice (soft drinks count) with a band in the background.

global.title: Not guitar, not drums
global.description: Someone playing an instrument that is not a guitar, drums or keyboard. Name the instrument in your comment; the most surprising wins.

global.title: Selfie with a performer
global.description: The best selfie with a performer, asked for politely and taken with their OK.

global.title: Handwritten sign
global.description: The best handwritten sign or chalkboard advertising tonight's gig.

global.title: Silhouette
global.description: The best silhouette of a performer or a crowd against the stage lights.

global.title: Dancing like nobody is watching
global.description: Someone dancing their heart out. Shoot from behind or ask first.

global.title: Seagull spotting
global.description: A seagull in the city centre. Bonus points for audience participation.

global.title: Wittiest T-shirt
global.description: The funniest band name or slogan on a T-shirt, from a distance. Shoot from behind.
